newsitem.title: UK: Soft oils firm in Europe on renewed Chicago rally.
newsitem.headline: Soft oils firm in Europe on renewed Chicago rally.

text.p: The renewed rally in Chicago soyoil futures on talk of export business gave soft oil prices in Europe a further boost towards the close on Thursday.
Soft oil prices rose a further 0.50 guilders with a firm dollar adding to the bullish feel to the market. However, trading was light and took place prior to the Chicago opening.

Palm oil remained on the defensive owing to lack of demand. Prices in Malaysia closed little changed with most players awaiting developments in Chicago. Traders said the market was trying to consolidate around current levels with the next data expected coming from Ivan Wong on Friday or Monday.
Coconut oil attracted some interest during the afternoon but the volume traded was small.
At the close Dutch soy oil was 1.75 to two guilders up after Nov/Jan traded at 101.50 guilders.
Dutch/EU rape oil finished two guilders higher with business reported in Aug/Oct at 103 guilders a 100 kilos fob ex-mill.
Crude palm oil sellers were $5 to $2.50 lower while products were unchanged to $2.50 up.
Coconut oil finished $20 to $12.50 down after Jun/Jul traded at $630 and Jul/Aug at $627.50 a tonne cif.
Palmkernel oil was neglected and closed with sellers $10 to $7.50 lower.
